en: Lance
I've been waiting for you, {player}.
I knew that one day you would stand here. Ever since the Lake of Rage, I've wanted to see how far you would go.
We fought side by side once. Today I stand in your way, as the League's Champion should.
My dragons have never been beaten in this room. Show me everything you have!
Lance
...It's over. I've lost.
You and your Pokémon have a bond I've rarely seen. You trusted each other, and that trust won through.
As the Champion, I'm proud to say it: you are the new Champion of the Pokémon League!
Mary
Oh, wait! Wait for us, please!
Mary
Is it over already? We've missed the whole thing! I'm Mary, from Pokémon Talk on the radio. I came to interview the new Champion!
Prof. Oak
Calm yourself, Mary. {player}, you've won. I heard it from the doorway. Congratulations, Champion!
When I handed you that Pokédex, I never dreamt you'd be standing here so soon. Your Pokémon trust you. That's the strength of a true trainer.
Lance
{player}, come with me. There is one room left, where the League keeps the names of its Champions.
Lance
Come, {player}. The Hall of Fame is through here.
